title: Kumamoto earthquake leaves at least 38 dead, thousands evacuated and widespread damage
summary: Authorities maintain humanitarian aid, the prime minister's visit and measures against heat and coronavirus in shelters as aftershocks continue.

title: Japan and the U.S. intervene for the first time in 15 years to halt the yen's fall
summary: The yen surges to 155 and 157 per dollar and Tokyo warns it will not hesitate to carry out new coordinated interventions.

title: 32-year-old employee arrested for creating fake sexual images of female students with AI
summary: Police are investigating the spread on social media of manipulated photos of minors based on real classroom images, in a case that reignites the debate over the use of artificial intelligence.

title: Shiho Kuwaki wins the Women's British Open and becomes the seventh Japanese woman to do so
summary: The Japanese golfer won in a playoff to claim her first Grand Slam title in front of her family.

title: Japan's government urges companies to disclose their intellectual property investments
summary: The new guideline seeks for intangible assets to be reflected in corporate valuation and long-term competitiveness.

title: Trump announces talks with Iran will begin starting August 3 with Oman's mediation
summary: Tehran says the consultations in Oman are in their final phase as expectations grow over the nuclear program and the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Extreme heat wave hits Japan, South Korea and Europe with temperatures above 40 degrees
summary: Authorities urge precautions against heatstroke, while extreme heat forces the shutdown of nuclear plants in Hungary and limits operations in France and Romania.

title: Oil falls on progress in U.S.-Iran dialogue and OPEC+ production increase
summary: Crude oil prices retreat in Asian markets on expectations of greater supply and a possible easing of tensions in the Middle East.

title: Nikkei on Tokyo Stock Exchange plunges more than 1,000 points
summary: Sell orders and rising U.S. yields weigh on the opening of the Japanese market.

title: 79-year-old man arrested for killing a coworker
summary: The suspect, a construction worker, said he argued with the victim and attacked him with a replica sword.

title: 33-year-old man arrested for strangling 91-year-old woman in Saitama
summary: The suspect confessed to killing her and said he entered the house to rob it because he was hungry.

title: Skating duo RikuRyu produces its first ice show after retiring
summary: In the final performance, the skaters said they maintain a lifestyle as if they were still competing.

title: Investigation into order to return to shopping center before explosion that killed a 22-year-old woman
summary: The victim's family received an apology from the company, while the legal responsibility for the order to return to the building is being analyzed.

title: Exhibitions and visits commemorate victims of atomic bombs in Japan
summary: Art displays and surviving violins, along with an increase in visitors to the Hiroshima museum, mark the approach of the anniversary.
